name: 20895 · Kensington, MD
findings: ZIP 20895 (Kensington) has 108 nonprofit organizations. 54 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 45 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20895 (Kensington) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 7 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
